successors.name: Liangzhu culture
successors.text: Hemudu, "22 km northwest of Ningbo", Yuyao "just south of the Hangzhou Bay in Jiangnan", and "the islands of Zhoushan"

ledger.x: 5500 BCE: the Hemudu rice farmers settle the Ningbo plain south of Hangzhou Bay ("c.
4000 BCE: the late Hemudu begins: "The culture may be divided into early and late phases, before and after 4000 BC respectively."

certainty.note: No border is recorded; Hangzhou Bay is the natural edge to the north.
